blocks.text: HOT TUB REMOVAL FAQ
Hot Tub Removal in Georgina — What to Know Before You Book

items.q: How much does hot tub removal cost in Georgina?
a: Pricing is confirmed free at the walkthrough based on the tub’s size, condition and access — with no waterfront or seasonal premium anywhere in the township.

items.q: Is there really no charge for waterfront or dock-adjacent properties?
a: Never. The same flat pricing applies at a Keswick townhouse and at the end of a private waterfront lane.

items.q: Do I need to drain the hot tub myself before you arrive?
a: No — draining is part of the service. You don’t need a hose, a pump, or any prep beyond reasonably clear access to the tub.

items.q: Is it safe to remove a hot tub that's still wired to electrical?
a: Only once the power is confirmed off. A hardwired 240V connection needs prior disconnection by a licensed electrician; plug-in portable spas just need unplugging.

items.q: Can you time removal to the docks-in or docks-out season?
a: Yes — tell the crew your property’s rhythm at the walkthrough and the job books around it.
